analysis: Both units are CHANGELOG.md-only (mode 100644 unchanged) text excerpts; no executable source changed in the supplied material. The changelog also states that App Attest rotation never revokes or denies serving, and that the 0.9.9 candidate excludes private-only providers from the public roster. I could not verify the described code, e.g. the rotation budget enforcement, the diagnostic stripping in coordinator/protocol/app_attest_deep_diagnostic.go, and the demand-aggregate suppression, because the supplied units contain no source diffs. The next pass should inspect those code paths for T-053/T-055/T-057/T-058, covering rotation-limit bypass via machine merges, authorization continuity after key replacement, and small-cohort leakage in the public demand statistics. No concrete security regression is evidenced by changelog prose alone.
